## Vehicle / configuration

State the exact known platform/engine/configuration. Do not include private registration/VIN data unless it is truly necessary and intentionally public.

## Claim

What signal or behavior do you believe is represented?

## Evidence class

Choose one:

- [ ] hypothesis
- [ ] observed
- [ ] measured
- [ ] repeated / confirmed
- [ ] manufacturer-documented

## Capture method

Describe interface, bitrate, listen-only configuration, logger/tool version and relevant conditions.

## Controlled experiment

What changed between baseline and action? Prefer one changed variable at a time.

## Candidate mapping

- CAN ID:
- standard / extended:
- DLC:
- byte/bit:
- endian:
- signed:
- factor:
- offset:
- unit:

## Reproduction

How many independent captures reproduce the behavior?

## Sanitization

- [ ] no credentials
- [ ] no private GPS track
- [ ] no registration/VIN document
- [ ] no unrelated personal telemetry

## Attachments / provenance

Link sanitized logs, plots, survey-session output, manual section or other evidence.
